title: Backend Engineering Intern
text:
Backend Engineering Intern
Kestrel Labs builds payment reconciliation tools for small businesses.
What you'll do
- Build and maintain REST APIs in Python (FastAPI)
- Write SQL against PostgreSQL and tune slow queries
- Ship features behind tests in our CI/CD pipeline
Requirements
- Strong Python and SQL fundamentals
- Understanding of REST APIs and data structures
- Familiarity with Git
Nice to have
- Docker and Kubernetes experience
- Exposure to AWS
Perks
- Stipend, mentorship, PPO opportunity
